description: Correlation field, confirmation_predicate, and freshness window for an MPC-signer backend, per docs/spec/guarantee-model.md "confirmation_predicate per backend" table (commit 66fd62f), pattern drawn from giskard09/turnkey-action-ref-anchor.
confirmation_predicate: same predicate as the on-chain backend (03) once the tx lands — the signer only adds an intermediate ACTIVITY_STATUS_* state before broadcast, which is not itself the confirmation
freshness_window: signer-side polling interval + underlying chain finality
